scope: Offline protected-state implementation and synthetic fixtures only

checks.command: bun run test -- test/protected-state.test.ts test/auth-migration.test.ts test/auth-export.test.ts

verifiedFixtureContracts: Every covered protected table and full-column digest
Monotonic key revocation and retained CHS capabilities/disabled billing
Legacy-only and CHS-only inputs; identity/billing/schema/outbox mismatches refused
Deleted-ID run/change high-water marks preserved; next feed ID advances beyond the source mark
Atomic page rollback, commit-then-lost-ack replay, row/receipt/conflicting-plan checks
Whole corpus ID/fingerprint and non-text metadata admission, including on resume
Owner-only artifacts, symlink/hardlink/sidecar/hash guards and privacy-safe errors
Restricted streamed SQL with explicit original sequence facts, chunked UTF-8/quote/comment handling
Missing authorizer and omitted/mismatched SQL sequence facts fail closed
Actual Bun SQLite and SQL prepare/apply-local/verify-local commands
Generated VIRTUAL/STORED columns in both source and target fail closed before output creation; ordinary extra-column refusal remains covered.
limits: Fixture data only; no actual protected backup was acquired or copied.
Offline files cannot establish common D1/KV freeze, writer/alarm quiescence or authenticity of acquired sequence history.
Actual production namespace/counter preservation, R2/Vectorize parity, remote apply and rollback remain separate approval/evidence gates.
SQL accepts the documented restricted dump subset and requires Node authorizer support; unsupported inputs are refused.
Full repository and Linux CI gates are not claimed by this focused validation.

Target text references and compact-text markers are not checked or restored by this helper; the supplied bundle check does not prove target text parity. Use separate text-cutover/compact-restore verification.
